panel_position: After the Auto color / Presets selector row; source colorFields order
enabled_rule: Gaussian editing Tools available, viewer ready, no selection draft, and either no processing or manual-color processing (processingColor); automatic-color and other processing disable fields.
reset_rule: No individual field reset. Color header Reset calls resetOperation(opacity), sets separate opacity UI scale to 1 and previews all 15 neutral grade values in current scope; it is disabled when grade is neutral and opacity is 1.
scope_rule: Current selection when selectedCount()!=0, otherwise all undeleted splats; selected/global scope change flushes and ends the current color session.
session_rule: First change captures colorBase; subsequent grades recompute from that original scene, avoiding compounding. endColorSession flushes, keeps baked content, clears colorBase and resets displayed grade to neutral.
preview_rule: Slider/preset edits call previewColor to set renderer grading values against captured colorBase; this is distinct from menu hover overlays.
commit_rule: AppUi calls commitColor when no ImGui item is active. If values differ from appliedColor and no job runs, CPU processing grades colorBase; successful changed replaceScene pushes an Undo revision and clears Redo. Do not assume one Undo for the whole session.
cancel_rule: Temporary numeric Escape restores captured formatted entry text, reparses/clamps and exits that field; it does not cancel the color session. Processing Cancel requests stop; an uncommitted color result restores settings to appliedColor. No dedicated whole-grading-session Cancel button observed.
pending_review: Matched native execution/captures and web comparison pending.
notes: Stored values are floats; displayScale changes UI units only. Passive display preserves stored precision; a real slider edit uses native format rounding, while temporary text parses numeric input and clamps. Section reset also affects the separately scoped opacity control.
